rv.q: Dirty Dancing is an enjoyable, engaging experience that delights the eyes and ears-the soundtrack, featuring a great deal of late 50s and early 60s rock, is superb-and engages the mind and heart as well.
"Dirty Dancing: the Musical" is a thoroughly entertaining night at the theater.

The only lead singing here comes from two minor characters who suddenly step up and belt out some of the cult classics indelibly linked with the film now and then. The instrumental underscoring even offers a nod to the swing era, with standards of yesteryear’s yesteryear. It’s now a well-crafted sho...
Overall, nostalgia is doing much of the heavy lifting until that final scene.
